text.content:
Sect: Sabbat (Tzimisce creation)

Szlachta and vohzd are not a revenant family — they are not a hereditary lineage at all, but individually surgically and mystically reshaped ghouls, each one a one-off creation rather than a child born into a bloodline. The Tzimisce make no special secret of the techniques, since they require mastery of Vicissitude (plus Bonecraft and at least two levels of Crafts with a Body Crafting focus) that effectively limits the practice to their own clan. They are grouped here alongside the true revenant families because they share Tzimisce vitae-manipulation roots, not because they reproduce the way Bratovitch, Grimaldi, Obertus, or Zantosa do.

Both types are explicitly unsuitable as player characters: the transformation leaves them with even less independent consciousness than a Conditioned vampire, and they should appear only as Storyteller-controlled creatures.

Szlachta (Guardian Ghouls)

Szlachta serve as soldiers, bodyguards, and sentries. Each is individually hand-crafted, so appearance varies, but most share spikes or armor plating, stripped or redistributed body fat, toughened or replaced skin, and armored, hyper-sensitive sensory organs. Creators typically starve or injure subjects beforehand to weaken the body's resistance to modification. Each transformation (armor, sensory enhancement, and similar modifications) requires the creator to win a Mental Challenge against the target's health levels and a Physical Challenge using Bonecraft; a tied Mental Challenge still grants the upgrade but saddles the szlachta with a Negative Trait (Heavy), capping out after the third such Trait. Anyone who knew the mortal a szlachta was made from can recognize the resemblance with a successful Static Mental Challenge, a discovery horrifying enough to require a Courage test to avoid fleeing.

Vohzd (War Ghouls)

Vohzd are massive, rarely-made-anymore war machines built from the surgically disassembled components of at least 15 sacrificed ghouls (human or animal), bound first in a Vaulderie-like shared-blood ritual and then taken apart with Vicissitude (sometimes aided by Thaumaturgy) into living "components" — heads for sensory organs, limbs, and general components for skeleton/muscle/organs. Building one is normally a team effort requiring time, multiple creators, and careful component storage. A finished vohzd automatically manifests Potence and Fortitude equal to twice the highest level held by any donor ghoul, a blood pool twice the largest contributing ghoul's pool, and moves at only half normal human speed. It has barely a mind of its own, obeying only short (three-word-or-less) commands from a single designated controller, and is wholly immune to Animalism, Dominate, and Presence. Vohzd are huge and require significant physical space and props to portray; anyone seeing one for the first time must resist fleeing in terror (a Courage test against five Traits, easing with repeated exposure).
